subject: Observability & logs renewal — consolidated negotiation and retention options
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-05-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Observability & logs renewal — consolidated negotiation and retention options

Team,

Our renewals for Datadog (APM + Logs), Grafana Cloud (metrics + optional logs), and Sentry (error monitoring) are all converging over the next 90 days. I pulled the vendor quotes and attached the most recent PDFs/CSVs — the big cost drivers are:

- Datadog: indexed logs and retention add-ons (we currently pay for 30 days of index + 90 days cold storage).
- Grafana Cloud: cheaper hot/cold splits but retention add-on pricing varies by ingestion pattern.
- Sentry: per-seat and volume tiers are increasing; we need a clearer SKU map.

As procurement lead, I want to propose a short list of options to try for negotiation:
1) Consolidate logs to Grafana Cloud (move metrics/APM split as needed), ask Grafana for migration credits.
2) Keep Datadog for APM but push for a negotiated indexed-logs cap and longer cold retention at discount.
3) Renegotiate Sentry seats or explore a blended seat + volume discount.

Can everyone review the attached quotes and reply with your top 2 preferences and any hard constraints (e.g., legal/regulatory retention needs, critical dashboards that must remain in current vendor). I want to present a recommended path to Finance by Friday 2026-05-15.

Attachments: Datadog_quote_Q2_2026.pdf, Grafana_cloud_quote_May2026.pdf, Sentry_SKU_breakdown.xlsx

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Sr. Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-05-11T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Observability & logs renewal — consolidated negotiation and retention options

Ben —

Quick thoughts after skimming:
- I'm leaning toward consolidating logs with Grafana Cloud for cost. Our retention needs are primarily 90 days for compliance and 1 year for audit access (cold). Grafana's hot/cold split looks promising if they can offer guaranteed restore latencies for cold.
- Keep Datadog for APM: the team's workflows are heavily tied to Datadog traces and alerts — migration cost/risk is high.
- Sentry: we should ask for a multi-year seat discount. We currently have a lot of trial/test users that can be cleaned up before renewal — I can run a license audit.

If Grafana will provide migration credits and a 20% discount on retention add-ons, I'm comfortable moving logs there. Otherwise, push Datadog hard on indexed volume caps.

Laura
Director, Platform Engineering

Thanks for the earlier conversations. We're entering a consolidated renewal window and evaluating options for reducing unit costs on logs retention while minimizing disruption to engineering workflows. Attached are the quotes we have on file. Two asks:

1) Can you provide a consolidated renewal proposal with line-item pricing for: base product, indexed logs (per GB), retention add-ons (30/90/365 days), and any migration credits you can offer?
2) If we decide to split responsibilities (Datadog APM + Grafana logs, or vice versa), what one-time migration support or credits would you extend?

Deadline: we'd like to receive initial proposals by 2026-05-14 so we can shortlist for vendor calls the week of 2026-05-18.

Subject: Re: Fwd: Observability & logs renewal — Request for consolidated pricing & retention options

Hi Ben —

Thanks for the detailed note and the attachments. We've put together a tailored proposal (attached: DD_proposal_20260513.pdf). Highlights:

- APM: 15% renewal credit if you commit for 12 months.
- Logs: we can cap indexed logs at current monthly volume and offer a 10% discount on index price; cold retention beyond 90 days can be kept at current rates for the first 6 months while you evaluate migration.
- Migration support: Datadog can provide up to 40 hours of consulting at no charge to help tune ingestion and filter noisy sources.

Notes/concerns:
- Indexed logs are still the main cost vector — aggressive retention increases dollars quickly. If you intend to keep very high-cardinality logs in index long-term, costs will remain material.
- We are open to discussing a phased approach (APM first, then logs) and will join a call next week.

Would 2026-05-19 at 10am PT work for a 30-minute call to review the proposal?

Best,
Alyssa Reed
Enterprise Renewals
Datadog

Ben —

Appreciate the outreach. I've attached a pricing breakdown (Grafana_cloud_pricing_breakdown.xlsx) and a migration offer. Key points:

- Logs retention: Grafana Cloud supports a hot/cold split; we can offer a 25% discount on the first year of cold storage and a migration credit equivalent to 3 months of ingestion fees.
- We can integrate with your existing dashboards and provide a migration playbook to keep alerting parity.
- If you consolidate logs with us and keep Datadog for APM, we will provide an assistance package for dashboard replication and 60 hours of engineering support.

We'd like to propose a short technical pilot to validate alert parity and restore times for cold data. If that sounds good, I'll block time the week of 2026-05-25.

Regards,
Marcus Liu
Strategic Accounts, Grafana Labs

Subject: RE: Observability & logs renewal — consolidated negotiation and retention options

Team —

Summary after vendor responses:

- Datadog: willing to give a 15% APM renewal credit, 10% discount on indexed logs, and 40 hours of free consulting. They are not offering a large cold-retention discount beyond a short-term concession.
- Grafana: stronger cold retention economics (25% first-year discount) + migration credits and 60 hours of support if we consolidate logs to Grafana Cloud.
- Sentry: no formal reply yet in this thread; I've also pinged renewals@sentry.io for a seat/volume SKU reduction — I expect a response by EOD Tuesday.

Recommendation (one-page attached):
1) Keep Datadog for APM and accept the 15% credit.
2) Move logs to Grafana Cloud for better retention economics, accept their migration credits and run a 2-week pilot focused on restore latency and alert parity.
3) Open a parallel negotiation with Sentry for a multi-year seat discount; Laura to run license audit to reduce seat count where possible.

Next actions:
- Laura: license audit for Sentry (due 2026-05-18).
- Tessa: schedule vendor pilot with Grafana (target start 2026-05-25).
- Vivek: confirm any legal/controls constraints on moving logs off Datadog (due 2026-05-17).
- Ben: draft consolidated negotiation memo for Finance (attached).

If there are objections, call them out by EOD today. Otherwise I'll move forward to schedule the pilot and Finance briefing.

Attachments: redwood_obs_renewal_summary_20260515.docx

Thanks,
Ben
Sr. Procurement Manager
